# PricingTable in camel_component_llm::cost - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/camel-component-llm/0.22.0/camel_component_llm/cost/struct.PricingTable.html

## Expand description

Per-model pricing for input and output tokens.

Prices are expressed as USD per 1,000 tokens (the standard LLM
billing unit). The `cost_usd()` method computes the total cost
given actual token counts.

## Fields[§](https://docs.rs#fields)

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.input_per_1k_tokens)

`input_per_1k_tokens: `[f64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.f64.html)Cost in USD per 1,000 input (prompt) tokens.

[§](https://docs.rs#structfield.output_per_1k_tokens)

`output_per_1k_tokens: `[f64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.f64.html)Cost in USD per 1,000 output (completion) tokens.

}## Expand description

Error taxonomy for LLM component operations.

Provider-agnostic — no provider-specific variants. Use the `Provider(String)`
catch-all for provider-specific errors; the constructor truncates messages
to 200 bytes with UTF-8 safety.

## Variants (Non-exhaustive)[§](https://docs.rs#variants)

## This enum is marked as non-exhaustive

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.RateLimit)

### RateLimit

Rate limited by provider; optionally carries a retry-after duration.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.QuotaExceeded)

### QuotaExceeded

Usage quota exceeded (e.g., billing limit reached).

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.ContextLengthExceeded)

### ContextLengthExceeded

Request exceeds provider context window.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.AuthFailed)

### AuthFailed

Authentication / authorization failure.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.ModelNotFound)

### ModelNotFound([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Requested model does not exist.

Model is temporarily unavailable (e.g., overloaded).

Provider endpoint is unreachable or returning server errors.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.ContentFiltered)

### ContentFiltered

Response was blocked by the provider’s content safety policy.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Network)

### Network([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Transient network error (connection reset, DNS failure, etc.).

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Timeout)

### Timeout([Duration](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/time/struct.Duration.html))

Request exceeded the configured timeout.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.InvalidRequest)

### InvalidRequest([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Request was malformed or violated provider constraints.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.UnsupportedCapability)

### UnsupportedCapability([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

The operation is not supported by this provider.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Protocol)

### Protocol([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Response could not be decoded or parsed.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.StreamInterrupted)

### StreamInterrupted([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Stream was terminated before completion.

### Provider([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

## This enum is marked as non-exhaustive

Non-exhaustive enums could have additional variants added in future. Therefore, when matching against variants of non-exhaustive enums, an extra wildcard arm must be added to account for any future variants.

# FinishReason in camel_component_llm::provider - Rust

```
pub enum FinishReason {
    Stop,
    Length,
    ToolCall,
    ContentFilter,
    Other(
```
[String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html)),
}## Expand description

Reason why a chat stream finished.

## Variants[§](https://docs.rs#variants)

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Stop)

### Stop

Model stopped naturally.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Length)

### Length

Response was truncated due to max tokens.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.ToolCall)

### ToolCall

Model requested a tool call.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.ContentFilter)

### ContentFilter

Response was filtered by content policy.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Other)

### Other([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Other reason.

# ToolChoice in camel_component_llm::provider - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/camel-component-llm/0.22.0/camel_component_llm/provider/enum.ToolChoice.html

```
pub enum ToolChoice {
    Auto,
    None,
    Specific(
```
[String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html)),
}## Expand description

Controls how the model chooses which tool to call.

## Variants[§](https://docs.rs#variants)

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Auto)

### Auto

Model may decide to call zero or more tools.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.None)

### None

Model must not call any tool.

[§](https://docs.rs#variant.Specific)

### Specific([String](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/string/struct.String.html))

Model must call the named tool.
